sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: A numeric representation used to compare text by similarity.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: Imagine placing sentences on a map where related meanings tend to be nearby. The map is imperfect.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: “Agent development environment” may be near related wording even without identical keywords.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: An authorized adapter can annotate eligible current chunks with a vector and explicit model/version metadata.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Similarity can complement exact word matching, especially when wording differs.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Production population remains inactive in this snapshot. Exact embedding retries are idempotent; changing a stored payload requires an explicit versioned contract.

sections.title: Implementation
